managementDisabledDescription: The platform operator turned module and plugin management off for this organization. Contact the platform operator to enable or disable modules.
title: Modules
description: Each module turns on a set of Aphel features. Some are work areas with their own menu item; others are supporting features that extend what the areas do. Disabling a module stops its screens and routines, but the data stays stored.
emptyDescription: This Aphel build includes no modules.
updateAvailableHint: This organization runs version {{installed}}; Aphel ships version {{version}}.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description: The module's screens, menus, widgets and automatic routines stop working for the whole organization. No data is deleted: enabling it again restores everything.
disable.withDependents: These enabled modules depend on {{name}} and will be disabled first, in this order: {{names}}. No data is deleted: when you enable them again, everything comes back as it was.

settings.title: Configure {{name}}
settings.description: Settings apply to the whole organization. Secrets are encrypted and never shown again.
settings.noFields: This module has no generic settings.
settings.requiredHint: Fill in the required fields to enable the module.
settings.secretConfigured: Already configured. Leave blank to keep the current value.
settings.extraPanelDisabled: Enable the module to see the other options.
settings.descriptionSetup: This module needs to be configured before it can be enabled. Check the fields below and save to enable it.

validation.url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
validation.unknown: This setting does not exist in this module.

purge.title: Remove {{name}} data
purge.description: Permanently deletes all data stored by the module in this organization.
purge.warning: This cannot be undone. Removed data can only be recovered from the exported file.
purge.exportStep: Before removing, export the data to keep a copy.

errors.module_incompatible: This module is not compatible with the current Aphel version or its dependencies.
errors.module_dependency_disabled: Enable the modules this one depends on first.
errors.module_settings_required: Fill in the required settings before enabling.
errors.module_required_by: Other enabled modules depend on this one. Disable them first.
errors.module_enabled: Disable the module before removing its data.
errors.module_export_required: Export the data after disabling the module before removing it.
errors.module_confirmation_required: The typed key does not match.
errors.actionFailed: The action could not be completed
errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.actionFailedFor: Could not complete the action on {{name}}

plugins.managementDisabledDescription: The platform operator turned plugin management off for this organization. Plugins that are already enabled keep working. To install or change plugins, contact the platform operator.
plugins.noDeclarations: This plugin declares no additional resources.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Third-party extensions installed from an .aphelplugin file or an .aphelpack pack with several plugins, without rebuilding or restarting Aphel. They run isolated and only reach what the plugin API allows.
plugins.backendFailedDescription: This plugin's backend no longer loads, so writes to the record types it hooks are blocked. Reinstall the plugin package to unblock them.
plugins.emptyDescription: Upload an .aphelplugin file or an .aphelpack pack to add entities, fields, rules and screens to Aphel.
plugins.uninstallDescription: The plugin, the entities it created (with their records) and the fields it added to other types will be removed.
plugins.settingsDescription: Values the plugin uses. Secrets are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
plugins.secretConfigured: Configured. Leave blank to keep it.
plugins.secretWillClear: The secret will be removed when you save.
plugins.consentDescription: Review what the plugin asks for. It will act with these permissions, limited to yours, including in events, scheduled routines and public routes.
plugins.consentNothing: The plugin does not ask for any special permission.
plugins.consentPublicWarning: Public routes can be called by anyone on the internet, without signing in.
plugins.consentHttpWarning: The plugin will be able to send CRM data to the listed addresses.
plugins.presetsDescription: Select the roles the plugin should create with its suggested permissions. Nothing is selected by default; existing roles only receive missing grants.
plugins.grantsIncomplete: Some roles are missing or do not have every permission the plugin expects. Create the roles in Settings › Roles and reapply the grants.
plugins.consentConflictsTitle: This plugin overlaps with plugins already installed
plugins.consentConflictsDescription: The plugins below touch the same things and may contradict each other.
plugins.consentConflictsAck: I understand these plugins contradict each other and want to continue
plugins.consentModuleDisables: This plugin disables the {{name}} module while it is installed. The module is enabled again when the plugin is uninstalled.
plugins.consentModuleBlocked: The {{name}} module cannot be disabled right now: {{blockedBy}}.
plugins.webWarning: This frontend runs inside Aphel with the access of each signed-in user who opens it. It can observe the interface and inputs, use browser storage, and call APIs allowed by that session. Backend capabilities do not restrict this JavaScript.
plugins.webRecovery: Only admit code and versions you trust as application code. Disabling stops future loading; reload open pages to clear loaded code. It does not undo completed effects. Supplier identity and code safety are not verified by this review.
plugins.webAdmission: I trust this version to run as integrated application code.
plugins.packConsentDescription: Several plugins at once, installed in the right order.
plugins.packOrderDescription: Installed in this order: a plugin that depends on another comes after it. Tap a plugin to see what it asks for. Nothing is installed if any of them has a problem.
plugins.packHasErrors_one: 1 plugin has a problem and blocks the pack. See below.
plugins.packHasErrors_other: {{count}} plugins have problems and block the pack. See below.
plugins.packNothingChanges: Every plugin of this pack is already installed in this version. There is nothing to update.
plugins.packSettingsDescription: Only where there is no value yet; what was already configured here does not change.
plugins.packUnchangedDescription: This plugin is already installed in this version and will not be touched.
plugins.packResultTitle: The {{name}} pack did not finish installing
plugins.packResultDescription: A plugin failed and the following ones were not installed. Fix the problem and send the pack again: it continues from where it stopped.
plugins.packPresetsDescription: The pack already checked the roles it suggests. Uncheck what you do not want created; existing roles only get the missing permissions.

screens.title: System areas
screens.description: Screens you open from the side menu.

support.title: Supporting features
support.description: They work behind the other screens and do not appear in the menu.

filters.noResultsDescription: Try another search or change the status filter.

enableChain.title: Enable {{name}}?
enableChain.description: {{name}} needs modules that are disabled. They will be enabled first, in this order: {{names}}.

config_packages.name: Configuration packages
config_packages.description: Exports and installs the system configuration (fields, pipelines, rules and other settings) as versioned packages, to repeat a setup in another organization.

documents.name: Documents
documents.description: Shared document rendering, layout and owner-authorized sources.

formulas.name: Formulas
formulas.description: Formula fields with validation, a result preview and recalculation when the fields they use change.
formulas.appears: as the Formula field type when creating fields

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Catalog to find and install plugins and configuration packages.
marketplace.appears: in Modules, with the catalog source

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: In-app and push notices, with delivery preferences per person.
notifications.appears: as a bell at the top of the screen and browser notices

objects.name: Custom objects
objects.description: Creates the organization's own record types, with fields and relationships, without coding.

publication.name: Publication
publication.description: Immutable revisions of publishable records, immediate and scheduled publication with approval policies, withdrawal and retention.
publication.appears: on publishable Site records, with revisions and scheduled publication

record_layouts.name: Record layouts
record_layouts.description: Defines how each record type is arranged on screen: tabs, sections and field order.

saved_views.name: Saved views
saved_views.description: Saved filters, columns and sorting for each list, personal or shared.
saved_views.appears: as saved views in record lists

search.name: Search
search.description: Global search over records, with an index kept up to date in the background.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Reminders before a task is due, the morning notice of tasks due today and standalone reminders linked to a record.
reminders.appears: as due reminders on tasks and the morning notice

validation_rules.name: Validation rules
validation_rules.description: Rules that block saving a record when a condition set by the organization is not met.

exports.description: Exports record lists to CSV and XLSX, respecting the filter, the search and what each person can see.
exports.appears: as an export action in record lists

dashboard.description: Home screen with panels (widgets) from each module, which each person can arrange their own way.

trash.description: Deleted records stay in the trash until permanent cleanup and can be restored with their links.

integrations.description: Integration center: connect Aphel to other services, with a single setup for the whole organization.

webhooks.description: Sends Aphel events to other systems (signed outgoing webhooks) and receives data that creates or updates records (incoming webhooks).

reports.description: Saved reports over records, with export and scheduled e-mail delivery.
reports.appears: as a saved report indicator on Home

money.description: The organization's currencies, dated exchange rates and conversion of amounts to the base currency.

scoring.description: Lead scoring models by profile and behavior, with cold, warm and hot bands and an explanation of each score.
scoring.appears: as a score tab on records

ai.appears: as an assistant tab on records, a writing tool in the e-mail editor and natural-language queries in lists

approvals.appears: as a tab on Deals and in the quote editor sidebar

assignment.appears: as the distribution rule picker where records are distributed

bulk_actions.appears: as bulk actions in record lists

catalog_items.appears: as a product picker when adding items to a record

deals.appears: in the Create button (Deal), with indicators and pending items on Home and a stalled-deal badge in lists

deals_revenue.appears: as a recurring revenue tab on Deals and an indicator on Home

duplicates.appears: as a merge action on record pages

email.appears: as an e-mails tab on records and in the timeline

enrichment.appears: as a public data tab on Companies and in the timeline

esign.appears: as a signatures tab on Deals and in the timeline

followers.appears: as a follow button on record pages

goals.appears: as a goal progress indicator on Home

imports.appears: as an import action in record lists and when a list is empty

insights.appears: as indicators on Home: deals by source, team activity ranking and birthdays

leads.appears: as a lifecycle tab on records, lead actions and a filter in lists

line_items.appears: as an Items tab on deals and in the timeline

messaging.appears: as a conversations tab on contacts and deals

notes.appears: as a notes tab on records, in the quick add of the + button and in the timeline

people.appears: in the Create button (Contact) and quick add

pricing.appears: as a Price lists link in Products and a bundles tab on product pages

proposals.appears: as a proposals tab on Deals

quotes.appears: as a quotes tab on Deals

renewals.appears: as a renewal section in pipeline settings and a renewals indicator on Home

sequences.appears: as a sequences tab on Contacts

tagging.appears: as a tags action on records and a filter in lists

tasks.appears: in the Create button (Task), in quick add (activity and check-in) and in the calendar

telephony.appears: in quick add (call), as a clickable phone and as a call panel on activities

timeline.appears: as the timeline on record pages

workflow.appears: as a stage guidance tab on records and a stalled-deals filter in lists

media.appears: as a library file picker in content editors
